chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from one of his companions, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimir, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about the advance payment (salaf) regarding meat. He said: 'Do not be near it, for sometimes he gives you the fatty, and sometimes the almost spoilt, and sometimes the boney. Buy it after viewing, hand to hand.'

He said: 'And I asked him about the advance payment regarding containers of water. He said: 'Do not go near it, for sometimes he gives you deficient, and sometimes complete, but buy it after viewing, and it is safer for you and for him.'

key_terms.السَّلَف: Advance payment or prepayment in a trade contract

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on advance payment (salaf) in Islamic trade according to the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the prohibition of 'salaf' (advance payment) in specific commodities like meat and water due to the risk of quality variance (gharar), a key concept in Shia commercial jurisprudence. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes 'mu'ayanah' (direct inspection) to ensure equity, reflecting the practical application of avoiding uncertainty in trade. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on protecting both buyer and seller from potential exploitation in immediate transactions.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from one of his companions, from Ahmad Bin Al Nazar, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the payment left behind regarding the meat.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not near it for sometimes he would give you the fatty, and sometimes the almost spoilt, and sometimes the boney. Buy it after viewing, hand to hand’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the payment left behind regarding the containers of water. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not go near it, for sometimes he would give you deficient, and sometimes complete, but buy it after viewing, and it is safter for you and for him’.
en.sarwar: 12. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from certain persons of his people from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from ‘Amr ibn Shamir from Jabir who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of advance payment for meat. He (the Imam) said, ‘You must not go close to it because one time he gives you fatty, one time what is about to become spoilled and one time he gives you boney. Buy with examination and in hand in hand manner.’

I then asked about advance payment for containers of water. He (the Imam) said, ‘You must not go close to it because one time he gives you less and one time complete. Buy it with examination; it is safe for you and for him.’”
